description: This file defines the Aws\Ssm\SsmClient class, a client for interacting with Amazon EC2 Simple Systems Manager (SSM) service. It contains method annotations for various SSM operations, indicating that it serves as a client interface to call AWS SSM APIs.

classes.name: SsmClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Systems Manager (SSM) providing methods to invoke various SSM API operations.

methods.name: addTagsToResource
methods.description: Adds tags to an AWS SSM resource.

methods.name: associateOpsItemRelatedItem
methods.description: Associates a related item with an OpsItem.

methods.name: createActivation
methods.description: Creates a new activation for managed instances.

methods.name: createAssociation
methods.description: Creates an association between a document and managed instances.

methods.name: deleteAssociation
methods.description: Deletes an association between a document and managed instances.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts a session to a managed instance.
